reproduction_target: Computational analysis of QIAseq miRNA sequencing data: raw single-end miRNA reads run through nf-core/smrnaseq (v2.3.1, default QIAseq settings) with FastQC/fastp trimming, alignment to GRCh38, gene-count matrices, UMI deduplication and miRTrace library-complexity metrics; plus an alternative branch with manual UMI deduplication using umi_tools + seqkit prior to the same pipeline. Downstream figures/PCA are secondary.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the 'Bioinformatic analyses' paragraph of the preprint Methods. nf-core/smrnaseq is kept as a single pipeline step (its internal components fastp/FastQC/miRTrace/aligner are managed by the pipeline release, not run standalone by the authors); umi_tools and seqkit are the author-invoked manual-dedup steps. No Data availability or Code availability statement is present in the preprint; the authors' own raw reads are not deposited (no GEO/SRA/ENA/DDBJ accession) and no author code/config repository exists. The only cited repository is the third-party pipeline itself (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13928318, github.com/nf-core/smrnaseq), not read at line level (stage1). Wet-lab library-prep/sequencing steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: nf-core/smrnaseq v2.3.1 pipeline run (Nextflow; default settings for QIAseq libraries; GRCh38 reference; FastQC/fastp trimming, alignment, gene-count matrices, miRTrace complexity, UMI dedup) on authors' raw miRNA reads
Manual UMI deduplication with umi_tools (no version) prior to nf-core/smrnaseq re-run with same settings
seqkit (no version; Shen et al. 2016/2024) sequence processing supporting the manual UMI-deduplication branch

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 3 computational steps cap at NI, not RI. The controlling blocker is data availability: the authors' own raw miRNA sequencing reads are not deposited (no Data availability statement, no GEO/SRA/ENA/DDBJ accession), so no pipeline step has a reachable input (data=0). Even setting that aside, only nf-core/smrnaseq carries an exact version pin (v2.3.1); the manual-dedup tools umi_tools and seqkit are unpinned and no author script/config exists. No environment lockfile or container is claimed by the authors (the nf-core release ships pinned envs, but that is a property of the third-party pipeline, not a capture claim in this paper). R star not assignable at stage1; no step could exceed RI even under stage2 without a deposited input dataset and an executed environment capture, neither of which is claimed to exist.
headline.coverage: 3 computational steps assessed from the 'Bioinformatic analyses' Methods paragraph of the biorxiv preprint (JATS XML). 5 wet-lab library-prep/sequencing steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.where: Bioinformatic analyses (input dataset) + missing Data availability statement
gaps.missing: The authors' own raw miRNA sequencing reads (52 libraries, Illumina NovaSeqXPlus, 100 bp single-end) are the entry point to every computational step but are not deposited under any GEO/SRA/ENA/DDBJ/ArrayExpress accession, and the preprint has no Data availability statement. Without the input data, no pipeline step can be re-run.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the raw FASTQ reads (and ideally a sample sheet mapping the 52 libraries to protocol/input/UMI conditions) in a public repository (GEO/SRA/ENA) and add a Data availability statement with the accession.

gaps.where: Whole computational pipeline (no Code availability statement)
gaps.missing: No environment lockfile, container digest, or conda/env spec is claimed by the authors, and no author code/config repository or parameter file is shared. Reproduction relies on prose alone: 'default settings for QIAseq' for nf-core/smrnaseq v2.3.1, plus a 'manual deduplication process using umi_tools and seqkit'.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the exact pipeline invocation / nextflow config, and a lockfile (conda-lock/pixi) or container digest; add a Code availability statement.

gaps.missing: umi_tools and seqkit carry no version numbers, and the Nextflow version used to run nf-core/smrnaseq v2.3.1 is not stated. These steps cannot reach RI.
gaps.how_to_close: Record exact versions (and builds) for umi_tools, seqkit, and Nextflow in a versions table or the Methods.

gaps.missing: The manual deduplication procedure is described only as 'using umi_tools and seqkit ... with the same settings' — the exact commands, UMI extraction/collapse parameters, and ordering are not given.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide the exact umi_tools/seqkit commands and parameters (e.g., a script) for the manual-dedup branch.
